FL\n}\n\nenum VehicleTypeCode {\n    TRUCK,\n    TRUCK24,\n    TRUCK10,\n    COVERED_TRAILER,\n    OPEN_TRAILER\n}\n\nclass RentalOffice\nattributes\n    name : String\n    number : Integer\n FL\n}\n\nenum VehicleTypeCode {\n    TRUCK,\n    TRUCK24,\n    TRUCK10,\n    COVERED_TRAILER,\n    OPEN_TRAILER\n}\n\nclass RentalOffice\nattributes\n    name : String\n    number : Integer\n FL\n}\n\nenum VehicleTypeCode {\n    TRUCK,\n    TRUCK24,\n    TRUCK10,\n    COVERED_TRAILER,\n    OPEN_TRAILER\n}\n\nclass RentalOffice\nattributes\n    name : String\n    number : Integer\n FL\n}\n\nenum VehicleTypeCode {\n    TRUCK,\n    TRUCK24,\n    TRUCK10,\n    COVERED_TRAILER,\n    OPEN_TRAILER\n}\n\nclass RentalOffice\nattributes\n    name : String\n    number : Integer\n
